messages:
Customer Rep - CloudNova: Hey CS, on our staging build users get intermittent 429s when multiple browser windows open the app at once. Happens only with staging key (stg-cloud-123).
Lina Torres: Thanks — is this the browser SDK init path? Any network snippets or response headers you can grab?
Customer Rep - CloudNova: Yes browser SDK. We see the init calling POST /v1/preflight. From Chrome network: status 429, header `x-rate-limit-phase: preflight` and body `\{"error":"rate_limited","detail":"concurrent_preflight"\}`.
Marco (EdgeOps): That header matches our gateway limiter on preflight auth. We throttle preflight per api_key with a small burst window to protect token issuer. Staging keys sometimes show this when many tabs start at once.
onboard-bot: Account: CloudNova trial started 2026-05-02 09:21 UTC
Lina Torres: Two practical workarounds: 1) have your frontend request a short-lived session token from your backend once and share it across windows (localStorage/sharedWorker) instead of doing full preflight per tab; 2) SDK can be toggled to dedupe concurrent preflight calls in-page. Which is easier for you?
Customer Rep - CloudNova: We're a single-page app but different browser windows don't share memory. Could we use localStorage fallback?
Samir Patel: Yes — if you backend issues an ephemeral token (expires ~5m) and frontend stores it in localStorage, new windows can reuse it. Example fetch to exchange API key server-side:
```
POST /exchange
Body: { apiKey: 'stg-cloud-123' }
Response: { session_token: 'sess_abc', expires_at: 1710000000 }
```
Then browser calls Redwood SDK with `sessionToken` header instead of raw api key.
Marco (EdgeOps): Meanwhile we can temporarily relax the preflight burst for that staging key for the next 24 hours. I'll need the exact key and a request ticket. We'll also add an audit tag for the change.
Customer Rep - CloudNova: Sending key in DM now. Quick Q: any client-side quick hack before server change?
Lina Torres: If you can patch the app quickly, use a sharedService that reads session_token from localStorage and if absent does a single fetch then sets a lock. For immediate tests, open tabs with slight randomized delay (200-800ms) to avoid synchronous fanout.
Samir Patel: For repro logging, run this in console to show headers: `fetch(\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preflight\", {method:'POST', headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer stg-cloud-123','Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({client:'browser'})}).then(r=>r.clone().text().then(b=>console.log(r.status, r.headers.get('x-rate-limit-phase'), b)))`
Customer Rep - CloudNova: Ran it 6x quickly: responses were 4x 200 and 2x 429. Got `x-rate-limit-phase: preflight` on the 429s.
Marco (EdgeOps): Got the DM with key; I provisioned a one-day burst increase for stg-cloud-123 and logged the change: ticket #OPS-9876. We'll monitor.
Lina Torres: Action items: 1) CloudNova implement session-token exchange (Samir offered snippet), 2) Marco will monitor gateway metrics and revert whitelist after 24h, 3) we'll add a tiny FAQ note in onboarding docs about avoiding parallel preflight from multiple windows.
Customer Rep - CloudNova: Implemented localStorage exchange and retested — no 429s on 8 concurrent windows. Thanks all!
Samir Patel: Great — we'll add a short example to the SDK recipes repo about session token exchange and a `preflightDedup` flag in the next patch.
Marco (EdgeOps): Closing provisional change in 24h unless you ask to extend. Leaving monitoring alerts for preflight failure rate.
Lina Torres: Closing the loop: will follow up with an email summarizing steps and link to the SDK recipe. :white_check_mark:
Customer Rep - CloudNova: Appreciated, team — smooth onboarding now.
